ln:4460191825.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering.

 Business: Fin, Supervision and TR Tech

Job ID: 56823

Principal Responsibilities

  • Design robust, resilient and scalable IT solutions and lead full stack engineers to develop and implement IT solutions to meet business users’ requirements.
  • Continuously enhance and transform the system to improve system observability, stability and scalability.
  • Establish best practices, guardrails, and standards for safe and effective engineering across the technology estate.
  • Lead DevSecOps transformation activities to improve OKRs including but not limited to improve release cadence, reduce incidents and reduce TOIL.
  • Drive technical capability uplift for the pod members.
  • Partner with architecture, SRE, DevOps, infrastructure, security, and support teams to align resilience activities with wider engineering priorities.
  • Ensure the IT risk and controls requirements are met.
  • Keep up to date and have expertise on current tools, technologies and areas like cyber security and regulations pertaining to aspects like data privacy, consent, data residency etc. that are applicable.

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • 8+ years IT experience in system development.,experience in in Financial Risk Management (especially investment banking products and market risk) is a plus.
  • Strong business-to-technology translation skills: able to analyze complex problems, gather and refine requirements, and convert them into clear artifacts such as user stories, process flows, system context diagrams, swimlanes, and solution proposals.
  • Solid engineering foundation across enterprise and cloud stack: Airflow,Python,Java/Scala, Microservices ,Database and APIs
  • Deep hands-on knowledge of container technology Kubernetes/Docker, including deployment behavior, failure handling, scaling, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems (spark or equivalent),failure modes, system recovery, and service resilience patterns.
  • Practical delivery and DevOps capability: hands-on with CI/CD and automation tools such as Jenkins and Ansible, plus Agile toolsets including Jira, Confluence, and GitHub.
  • Proven leadership in execution: experience leading developers and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, sustainable changes that measurably improve business outcomes.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management: fluent spoken and written English, strong documentation, with the ability to influence across engineering teams and key stakeholders
  • Demonstrated resilience mindset, with a strong focus on proactive risk reduction and continuous improvement.

What additional skills will be good to have?

  • Business knowledge in Traded Risk
  • Agile or DevOps experience.
  • Strong experience with GCP and cloud-native platforms, including operational and resilience considerations.
  • Any Open Source project participation or any GitHub or blog publication.

Job Board Tags

 /WX

/51

/LP

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

ln:4459166845.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

The Group AI Platform team sits within CTO Platforms, part of HSBC’s Chief Technology Office (CTO). We build shared AI foundations that enable teams across the Bank to deliver AI solutions faster, more safely and at scale.

Our platform provides a “paved road” for AI delivery, bringing together seamless access to AI models and infrastructure, a consistent Agent HUB to build, deploy and manage production-ready AI agents, reusable AI capabilities (such as knowledge management and document intelligence), and built-in controls including guardrails, evaluation and monitoring to support responsible adoption.

We’re a global team with an established footprint across Asia (Hong Kong, Mainland China, India) and Europe (Poland, UK), and we continue to expand to support delivery across regions. Joining the team means working at the centre of HSBC’s AI enablement—partnering with multiple lines of business and functions across regions to turn AI capabilities into reliable, repeatable services that deliver measurable business value.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Associate Director, Software Engineering(AI Platform Programme Manager )

Business:CTO Platforms (AI Platform)

Job ID：57003

Location: GZ/XA

Principal Responsibilities

  • Act as Programme Manager for the Group AI Platform by defining strategy, developing plans, tracking progress, and driving execution of platform-wide objectives across multiple teams.
  • Drive continuous improvement through a data-driven approach, using insights to strengthen delivery performance and operational outcomes.
  • Engage and communicate with global stakeholders to align priorities and ensure successful delivery.
  • Resolve issues and remove blockers to keep delivery on track and enable successful outcomes.
  • Provide consistent programme reporting on milestones, RAID items, and financials where applicable, providing clear visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and required decisions.
  • Embed high-performing ways of working, including Agile delivery, clear ownership, measurable outcomes, and strong controls aligned to a regulated environment.
  • Coach and influence leaders and teams to strengthen execution discipline, accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.

Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; 10+ years of programme / project management experience, with strategy management experience preferred.
  • Extensive experience of leading complex, cross functional technology initiatives across global teams and senior stakeholders.
  • Strong ability to translate strategy into executable roadmaps with measurable outcomes, drive delivery and continuous improvement.
  • Excellent English communication skills, with the ability to provide crisp executive updates, develop well-structured materials, and facilitate effective decision-making.
  • Familiarity with Agile frameworks and experience managing delivery using Agile ways of working.
  • Proven ability to manage stakeholders and influence diverse teams, building alignment across competing priorities.
  • Experience of managing AI/ML solutions or platforms delivery is preferred, along with a passion for AI/ML and the ability to learn quickly in a fast-moving environment.

/51/LP/WX

About HSBC Technology China

We develop, implement and support software and IT services and processes that allow HSBC to remain at the forefront of high-quality banking systems.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

ln:4459181794.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Developing our Premier customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier clientele portfolio
  • Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs
  • Promoting our Premier Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate
  • Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance
  • 扩大卓越理财客户群，并与卓越理财客户建立长期关系
  • 根据客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富
  • 向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门
  • 配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline
  • Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability
  • Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills
  • High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers
  • Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets
  • Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure
  • Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills
  • Fluency in Mandarin and English
  • 本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳
  • 具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系
  • 具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流
  • 以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务
  • 了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣
  • 成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现
  • 具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧
  • 普通话及英语流利

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Developing our Premier customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier clientele portfolio
  • Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs
  • Promoting our Premier Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate
  • Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance
  • 扩大卓越理财客户群，并与卓越理财客户建立长期关系
  • 根据客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富
  • 向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门
  • 配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline
  • Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability
  • Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills
  • High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers
  • Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets
  • Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure
  • Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills
  • Fluency in Mandarin and English
  • 本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳
  • 具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系
  • 具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流
  • 以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务

  • 成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现
  • 具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧
  • 普通话及英语流利

ln:4432183779.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist.

Business: CTO Data Technology

Job ID:49388

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead API Modernization: Spearhead the architectural design and execution of our strategic API migration from MuleSoft to Spring Boot, ensuring a seamless, scalable, and maintainable transition.
  • Drive Platform Strategy: Act as a key technical authority for MongoDB-related initiatives, guiding platform adoption, enhancement, and administration across our enterprise environment.
  • Manage Critical Migrations: Take ownership of delivering complex migration projects, including a multi-year MongoDB version upgrade and the migration of the IKP namespace cluster, with a focus on stability and minimal disruption.
  • Optimize System Performance: Lead infrastructure resource planning, performance tuning, and configuration optimization to ensure our platforms are efficient, resilient, and ready for future demands.
  • Champion DevOps Practices: Contribute to the implementation and refinement of our CI/CD pipelines, driving automation and improving engineering efficiency and deployment quality.
  • Collaborate and Communicate: Foster strong cross-regional collaboration between development, infrastructure, and operations teams to align on technical initiatives and ensure successful project delivery.
  • Build Team Capability: As a founding member of the new CDMS PODs team, you will help establish best practices and build the team’s technical foundation, accelerating solution delivery.

Requirements

  • Expert-Level API & Microservices Experience: Proven experience in designing, building, and leading complex API solutions. Direct, hands-on experience migrating services from MuleSoft to Spring Boot is essential.
  • Strong MongoDB Expertise: Deep knowledge of MongoDB, covering both development support and enterprise-level administration (configuration, performance tuning, environment management).
  • Proven Migration Leadership: A successful track record of leading large-scale database and platform migration projects (e.g., version upgrades, platform transformations) with a keen eye for execution quality.
  • DevOps and Automation Mindset: Practical knowledge of CI/CD concepts and tools, with experience in supporting and improving modern software delivery processes.
  • Exceptional Leadership & Communication: Strong ability to lead technical teams, collaborate across different regions and functions, and communicate complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
  • Proactive and Ownership-Driven: A proactive problem-solver with a strong sense of ownership, capable of driving initiatives from concept to completion and mentoring new team members.
  • HSBC Experience (Preferred): Previous working experience within HSBC's technical environment is a significant plus.

/WX

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***
